name: DFIR-IRIS
description: Incident response case management platform for organizing evidence, timelines, and collaborative investigations.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      POSTGRES_SERVER: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      RABBITMQ_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-rabbitmq"
      IRIS_SECRET_KEY: {{env.IRIS_SECRET_KEY}}
      IRIS_SECURITY_PASSWORD_SALT: {{env.IRIS_SECURITY_PASSWORD_SALT}}
      IRIS_ADM_PASSWORD: {{env.IRIS_ADM_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/certs:/home/iris/certificates
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/home/iris/server_data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: iris_db
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3-management
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-rabbitmq
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-worker:
    image: ghcr.io/dfir-iris/iriswebapp_app:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-worker
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: worker
